basic_details.job_title: Pt. MMMH Junior Resident Doctors Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital (Pt. MMMH), New Delhi, Delhi, has invited applications for 2 posts of Junior Resident Doctors under Advt No. 15/2026. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 25 November 2026.

age_limit.age_details: 30 yrs for General candidates, 35 yrs for SC/ST candidates, 33 yrs for OBC candidates (as on the date of interview)

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS Degree recognized by MCI; registered with Delhi Medical Council; must not have completed one year Junior Residency; internship completed by 24/11/2026 and not before 25/11/2024. Preference to fresh candidates.
qualification.details: Qualification: MBBS Degree recognized by MCI; must be registered with Delhi Medical Council and have not completed one year Junior Residency; must have completed Internship by 24/11/2026 and not before 25/11/2024. Preference will be given to fresh candidates. Age limit: 30 yrs for General candidates, 35 yrs for SC/ST candidates, 33 yrs for OBC candidates (as on the date of interview) Age relaxation: SC/ST 35 years, OBC (Delhi) 33 years, Persons with benchmark disabilities Upper age limit relaxable by 10 years | Other conditions: | Must be registered with Delhi Medical Council Only OBC (Delhi) candidates get OBC reservation or age relaxation; OBC (Outside) candidates must apply under UR OBC candidates must hold a non-creamy layer certificate with caste certificate on or before the cut off date PH candidates with OA, OL (One Arm, One Leg) considered with aids; bilateral hand activities should be adequate Candidates already in government service should submit a NOC from their employer | Desirable: | Preference will be given to fresh candidates

salary_details.pay_scale: Basic Pay Rs. 56,100 + NPA in Pay Level 10 (Index-1) and other allowances

how_to_apply: Download the application form annexed to the notice; no form will be provided at the time of interview.
Fill in the form and affix a recent passport size photograph.
Attach attested photocopies of the listed certificates in the order given.
Report at Conference Hall, 3rd Floor, Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-17 on 25-11-2026.
Register between 09.00 AM and 11:00 AM with all original certificates and testimonials.
Submit the duly completed application form on the day of interview.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview If the interview date is declared a holiday, the interview will be held on the next working day at the same venue and time Results on http://health.delhigovt.nic.in and by email; no telephonic call will be made Give an appropriate email id during document verification Appointment subject to medical fitness and verification of certificates The hospital reserves the right to change the number of vacancies or withdraw the process

rows.pt_madan_mohan_malaviya_hospital_pt_mmmh: Basic Pay Rs. 56,100 + NPA in Pay Level 10 (Index-1) and other allowances
Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi

MBBS Degree recognized by MCI; registered with Delhi Medical Council; must not have completed one year Junior Residency; internship completed by 24/11/2026 and not before 25/11/2024. Preference to fresh candidates.
30 yrs for General candidates, 35 yrs for SC/ST candidates, 33 yrs for OBC candidates (as on the date of interview)

content_sections.heading: Pt. MMMH Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 15/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Pt. MMMH notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS Degree recognized by MCI; must be registered with Delhi Medical Council and have not completed one year Junior Residency; must have completed Internship by 24/11/2026 and not before 25/11/2024. Preference will be given to fresh candidates. Age limit: 30 yrs for General candidates, 35 yrs for SC/ST candidates, 33 yrs for OBC candidates (as on the date of interview) Age relaxation: SC/ST 35 years, OBC (Delhi) 33 years, Persons with benchmark disabilities Upper age limit relaxable by 10 years Other conditions: Must be registered with Delhi Medical Council Only OBC (Delhi) candidates get OBC reservation or age relaxation; OBC (Outside) candidates must apply under UR OBC candidates must hold a non-creamy layer certificate with caste certificate on or before the cut off date PH candidates with OA, OL (One Arm, One Leg) considered with aids; bilateral hand activities should be adequate Candidates already in government service should submit a NOC from their employer Desirable: Preference will be given to fresh candidates

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Pt. MMMH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who have completed one year Junior Residency Candidates who completed internship before 25/11/2024

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Adhoc appointment initially for 89 days, extendable up to a maximum of one year including previous JR experience, or till recruitment by Centralized Committee, whichever is earlier Candidates with less than one year JR elsewhere get residency only for the residual period Service governed by the Residency Schemes of Govt. of India and Central Civil Services (Temporary Service Rules 1978) Selected candidates get a maximum of 07 days to join, otherwise the offer is cancelled JRs will not be eligible for Child Care Leave

content_sections.heading: How Will Pt. MMMH Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Scrutiny of applications and enclosures Final list of selected cum waitlisted candidates as per merit Registration closes at 11.00 AM sharp; no candidate entertained after 11.00 AM Incomplete applications or those without proper enclosures will be rejected Panel/waitlist for each category valid only till exhausted Decision of the Selection Board/Medical Superintendent Pt. MMMH is final

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Date of Birth (Class Xth Certificate) DMC Registration (as applicable) and Internship completion certificate/FMGE (25.11.2024 to 24.11.2026) SC/ST/OBC Caste certificate issued by the competent authority (if applicable) MBBS degree, MBBS Mark sheets and Attempt Certificates UDID Card/Certificate for PwBD; Income Certificate for OBC & EWS issued within six months Experience certificate and Undertaking, if any; one recent passport size photograph

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Pt. MMMH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form annexed to the notice; no form will be provided at the time of interview. Fill in the form and affix a recent passport size photograph. Attach attested photocopies of the listed certificates in the order given. Report at Conference Hall, 3rd Floor, Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-17 on 25-11-2026. Register between 09.00 AM and 11:00 AM with all original certificates and testimonials. Submit the duly completed application form on the day of interview.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview If the interview date is declared a holiday, the interview will be held on the next working day at the same venue and time Results on http://health.delhigovt.nic.in and by email; no telephonic call will be made Give an appropriate email id during document verification Appointment subject to medical fitness and verification of certificates The hospital reserves the right to change the number of vacancies or withdraw the process

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Pt. MMMH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Pt. MMMH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Junior Resident Doctors.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Pt. MMMH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates: No fee payable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 yrs for General candidates, 35 yrs for SC/ST candidates, 33 yrs for OBC candidates (as on the date of interview). Relaxation: SC/ST 35 years, OBC (Delhi) 33 years, Persons with benchmark disabilities Upper age limit relaxable by 10 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Basic Pay Rs. 56,100 + NPA in Pay Level 10 (Index-1) and other allowances.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS Degree recognized by MCI; registered with Delhi Medical Council; must not have completed one year Junior Residency; internship completed by 24/11/2026 and not before 25/11/2024. Preference to fresh candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be registered with Delhi Medical Council. Only OBC (Delhi) candidates get OBC reservation or age relaxation; OBC (Outside) candidates must apply under UR. OBC candidates must hold a non-creamy layer certificate with caste certificate on or before the cut off date. PH candidates with OA, OL (One Arm, One Leg) considered with aids; bilateral hand activities should be adequate.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have completed one year Junior Residency. Candidates who completed internship before 25/11/2024.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Scrutiny of applications and enclosures. Final list of selected cum waitlisted candidates as per merit. Registration closes at 11.00 AM sharp; no candidate entertained after 11.00 AM.
